"scripts": {

    "judge:demo": "node scripts/dealtwin/local-demo.mjs",
    "judge:test": "node node_modules/vite-node/vite-node.mjs --config vitest.config.ts scripts/dealtwin/prepare-browser-fixture.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.dealtwin.config.ts",
    "start": "vinext start",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "security:client": "node scripts/dealtwin/check-client-artifacts.mjs dist/client",
    "benchmark:dealtwin": "node node_modules/vite-node/vite-node.mjs --config vitest.config.ts evaluation/dealtwin/cli.ts --",
    "lint": "eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate"
  },

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "incremental": true,
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "next"
      }
    ],
    "types": ["@cloudflare/workers-types"],
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["./*"]
    }
  },
  "include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts",
    "**/*.mts"
  ],
  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
}

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: dealtwin
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dealtwin
          POSTGRES_DB: dealtwin_test
        ports:
          - 55432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U dealtwin -d dealtwin_test"
          --health-interval 2s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20
    env:
      # Disposable CI owner only bootstraps schema; harness operations use distinct least-privilege logins.
      DEALTWIN_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://dealtwin:dealtwin@127.0.0.1:55432/dealtwin_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.0
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run lint
      - name: Candidate provenance (runner-local files only)
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          git rev-parse HEAD > artifacts/candidate-sha.txt
          node --version > artifacts/node-version.txt
          npm --version > artifacts/npm-version.txt
      # One serial coverage run includes the whole suite and real PostgreSQL cases.
      - name: Required full regression and per-module coverage
        run: npm run test:coverage -- --testTimeout=60000 --hookTimeout=60000 --reporter=dot --reporter=json --outputFile=artifacts/tests.json
      - name: Preserved Cloudflare target (build only)
        run: npm run build
      - name: Cloudflare public-client artifact hygiene
        run: npm run security:client
      - name: Node PostgreSQL Judge target (build only)
        run: npm run judge:build
      - name: Node public-client artifact hygiene
        run: npm run security:client
      - name: Current dependency audit — high/critical block
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high --json > artifacts/npm-audit.json
      # No automatic artifact upload or external publication is authorized here.

watch: !stdEnv.isCI && process.stdin.isTTY,
	globals: false,
	environment: "node",
	pool: "forks",
	clearMocks: false,
	restoreMocks: false,
	mockReset: false,
	unstubGlobals: false,
	unstubEnvs: false,
	include: defaultInclude,
	exclude: defaultExclude,
	teardownTimeout: 1e4,
	forceRerunTriggers: ["**/package.json/**", "**/{vitest,vite}.config.*/**"],
	update: false,
	reporters: [],
	silent: false,
	hideSkippedTests: false,
	api: false,
	ui: false,
	uiBase: "/__vitest__/",
	open: !stdEnv.isCI,
